BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

A few helpful answers.

What time is check-in?

Check-in is between 13:00 and 19:00. Please advise the property of your expected arrival time.

What time is check-out?

Check-out is by 11:00.

How many guests can stay?

The two-bedroom apartment accommodates up to four guests.

Is parking available?

Yes. Free private on-site parking is available.

Is Wi-Fi available?

Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available, with approximately 35 Mbps service.

Is there a restaurant, pool or airport shuttle?

No. There is no on-site restaurant, swimming pool or airport shuttle service.

Does the apartment have a balcony?

Yes. The apartment includes a balcony.

Are children welcome?

Children of all ages are welcome. Children aged 13 and above are charged as adults where relevant to the booking platform.

Are pets, smoking or parties allowed?

No. Pets, smoking, parties and events are not permitted.

Are cots or extra beds available?

No. Cots and extra beds are unavailable.

Is there an age restriction for check-in?

No age requirement is specified in the supplied property information.
